scope: Software representation and local Node/Python wire validation only; no training, policy rollout, model selection, held-out evaluation or deployment
hypothesis: A fixed continuous three-frame observation history with explicit known/time masks can represent measured drift and distinguish missing evidence from measured zero without exposing diagnostic world truth or the current selected action.
boundary_rules: Only canonical simulation features and sidecar-v2 original record identities; same epoch and increasing original clocks/sequences.
Cut history at gaps over300ms or noncontiguous record sequence; reject cross-epoch histories and conflicting current records.
Recompute age at encoding from original capture clocks; unknown numeric=0 with known=0, measured zero=0 with known=1.
Only causal previous original requests; do not encode current selected action, seed, geometry label, reward, raw world coordinates or motor-derived measured velocity.
Action mask is seven navigation requests only; operator recovery may be historical input, never an actor action.
One latest pending inference per explicit client session; cancellation, replay, old epoch/sequence and clock regression cannot restore cancelled proposals.
Reply must match original session/request, epoch/record, vector digest, model schema, allowed action and exclusive original observation+300ms deadline.
No clocks are refreshed by Python or inference wait; digital fixture output is not physical command authorization.
python_scope: Decode canonical Node vector, validate shape/domain/mask/digest and exercise explicit masked-argmax fixtures. No trained model, optimizer, replay memory or training code loaded.

test_recipe.runner: Node built-in test runner with Python subprocess fixtures; no environment step or policy runner
test_recipe.saved_input_purpose: Encode existing full accepted records once; do not reconstruct omitted trajectory or replay the plant.
checks: Causal request history and epoch/clock/record boundaries
Reply bindings, mask, expiry, cancellation and replay
Exact JSON roundtrip of all234values and binary64LE digest between Node and Python
Strict Python JSON, numeric and semantic validation

gate: All targeted checks pass and immutable upstream evidence/source hashes match; review approves only component use and separate learning architecture/protocol preflight, never physical or deployment readiness
